title: SAHI roadmap: 32 recommendations for AI in Indian healthcare
takeaways: SAHI sets out 32 recommendations across five pillars.
85% of Indian consumers already use AI for health (BCG).
110 crore health records are linked to ABHAs.
71% of clinicians say AI raised their patient capacity.
DPDP penalties reach ₹250 crore from 13 May 2027.
source_note: Sources: eHealth Nov 2026; BCG 2026; NHA; Philips FHI 2026; Uniqus
